payload.body: Delta read of cc/desks1126 (wt-desks1125) at 1ee77ee1: SOUND. (1) 0bd47f17..b4390952: MC.press answers true, or nil and a reason, for all four of performAction's answers (element, false, nil+message, a raise), each an mc_test arm; MC.shown reads only the owners' mc.display. (2) b4390952..ff6047fc: A's three commits, ic's toasts included, equal 381cc5cb..365d3cf3's +/- lines except README's two, which main already holds as 86596d53, so the base carries them. (3) ff6047fc..1ee77ee1: show_by_tile and exec_remove_space call M.mission_control's goto_space and remove_space under the same pcall; no live hs.spaces edit call is left in opt/arngz/lib; engine_test's and log_test's shims answer through their fakes' hs.spaces, so their arms stand; arngz.bats has no fake edit call. Note, no change: a refused press reads as transient in P.space_error_kind, so a create retries it, as a nil from hs.spaces did before.
